notes.iowa-city-public-library: The city's public library, not the university's.
notes.robert-a-lee-community-recreation-center: The City of Iowa City's recreation centre, not a university gym.
notes.la-james-international-college: A private beauty college, not the university.
notes.northside-commons: A building=yes with no other tags in OSM; not one of the university's dining halls.
notes.bowman-house: Women's Resource & Action Center offices; no classes.
notes.area: No campus outline exists (see config area.note), so every named building in the box was a candidate; the non-university ones are hidden here.

detours.why: The Iowa River lies between Catlett (west campus) and the Dance Building; the walk crosses it on a footbridge.
Buildings fill the block between Daum and the Pappajohn Business Building, whose mapped way in is from its west courtyard, so the walk goes round.
